lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as at least five distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots spanning the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid-like appearance across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from bright illumination on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (suckerfish) are visible: one along the upper dorsal ridge and several others near the ventral pectoral region.
